name: Midas mMEV
oneLiner: mMEV is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping MEV Capital's DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, and liquidation strategies; not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: MEV Capital-managed DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies allocated through Midas liquid-yield token rails.
pegMechanism: Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token with primary mint/redeem through Midas rails; it does not maintain a fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

oracleRisk.summary: mMEV is a NAV-accreting Midas Liquid Yield Token tracking a delta-neutral DeFi strategy; its underlying protocols can have liquidation risk, but mMEV is not itself a borrower CDP.

branchApplicability.rationale: Midas describes mMEV as a Liquid Yield Token for an MEV Capital-managed, delta-neutral strategy and separately identifies on-chain liquidation calls as one possible strategy activity. The reviewed product materials do not describe mMEV tokenholders opening borrower-owned debt positions or a token-level collateral threshold, liquidation engine, backstop, or shutdown branch; risks in underlying DeFi protocols are not an mMEV CDP branch to inventory under V9.

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mMEV is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mMEV is issued natively by Midas on Ethereum, Plume, and Etherlink. Row-level on-chain verification on 2026-07-20: each deployment is a Midas-administered transparent proxy (EIP-1967 impl/admin slots read on all three chains), no LayerZero endpoint() surface exists on any of them, and the verified mint-authority review (2026-07-13) confirms each chain mints through its own Midas deposit-vault minter holding M_MEV_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE plus Midas admin EOAs under chain-local 1-of-3 Safes. No third-party bridge carries the representation; cross-chain movement is issuer-operated.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-8 (lead usdy-ondo-finance)

reserves.name: MEV Capital DeFi strategy NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: MEV Capital (strategy manager) via Midas mMEV liquid-yield token

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies the live mMEV exposure as a MEV Capital managed DeFi strategy NAV — the issuer disclosures describe dynamic allocation across DeFi lending, liquidity provision, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies — but does not disclose the current underlying assets, venue allocations, or custody providers. The slice is named to match the live chainlink-nav reserve adapter capture (assetLabel 'MEV Capital DeFi strategy NAV') so the reviewed classification overlays the captured exposure; it remains a bounded aggregate with the underlying allocation explicitly unresolved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas mMEV product, risk, and transparency disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete current underlying strategy allocation, venue exposures, and custody providers are undisclosed; the single NAV slice is the whole envelope, with the strategy internals intentionally unresolved.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The product is disclosed only as a managed DeFi strategy NAV without a current structured underlying asset and failure-domain inventory.

providers.name: Midas mMEV issuance and redemption vault contracts (Ethereum)
MEV Capital strategy wallets and trading venues (undisclosed)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Midas documents the mMEV token, issuance and redemption vaults, and NAV data-feed contracts, and the strategy disclosures describe a dynamically allocated managed DeFi strategy, so strategy assets are actively deployed and reused by design. The underlying strategy wallets, trading venues, custodians, provider shares, legal segregation, and bankruptcy-remoteness terms are not disclosed.

mintAuthority.summary: mMEV has independently mintable deployments on Ethereum, Plume, and Etherlink. A chain-local deposit vault and EOA 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 can mint on every deployment, while EOA 0x0383a2a62cd962a4780f615b5fa2a0ffc07ed1d2 is an additional Ethereum minter. Each chain's 1-of-3 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe and shared admin EOA can change those grants immediately; proxy upgrades pass through a two-day chain-local timelock.

routeChecks.signingModel: Each chain-local upgrade Safe is 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard. The owner sets differ by chain, so the failure-domain keys retain each Safe independently.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Every current ProxyAdmin is owned by a chain-local MidasTimelockController whose getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Each local Safe was the timelock's sole proposer, executor, and canceller; the delayed proxy-upgrade route is separate from immediate MidasAccessControl role administration.

review.evidence: Pinned chain state was reviewed at Ethereum 25527148, Plume 80928370, and Etherlink 48212139. M_MEV_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holders were: Ethereum EOAs 0x0383a2a62cd962a4780f615b5fa2a0ffc07ed1d2 and 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 plus vault 0xe092737d412e0b290380f9c8548cb5a58174704f; Plume EOA 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 plus vault 0xe6f0c60fca2bd97d633a3d9d49dbefdf19636d8c; Etherlink EOA 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 plus vault 0x577617613c4fac5a7561f8f3f2cb128a560774bc. Every chain also retained its local 1-of-3 Safe and shared EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 as immediate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders. All current mint-critical transparent proxies resolved through chain-local ProxyAdmins to two-day timelocks controlled by those local Safes. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Midas publishes recurring collateral/NAV checkpoints through its Attestation Engine, with source notarization and independent LlamaRisk or Canary verification; the live transparency dashboard was reviewed on 2026-07-15. FMA prospectus approval is not issuer prudential licensing.
review.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 registry pass

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Midas describes mMEV as tracking delta-neutral DeFi crypto yields under a stable-asset exposure mandate. Its documented same-underlying liquidity provision, statistical arbitrage, and carry trades are explicitly market-neutral, which fits the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype.
